name: WhatsApp Business
one_liner: Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Cloud API (HTTP, webhooks); the on-premises API was shut down.
auth_notes: Not verified on an official page (Meta docs returned HTTP 400 to fetch). Commonly a Meta access token (system user or user token) sent as Bearer; unverified.
access_notes: Free API access, per-message billing. Needs a Meta developer app, business portfolio, phone number, approved display name; business verification to raise limits. Test number available. Third-party sources only.

buildability.rationale: Cloud API is the only option since on-premises ended; self-serve start with test number, but production needs business verification, template approval and per-message billing. Official docs not retrievable.

needs_human_reason: Meta developer docs block automated fetch (HTTP 400); auth, endpoints, rate limits and MCP status rest on third-party blogs.

access.quote: You create a Meta developer app, add the WhatsApp product, connect it to your business portfolio and get a test number
Production needs your own number, an approved display name and, to raise limits, business verification.
